text.content:
Entropists are among the few gifted with the ability to channel the reality-bending energies of the Cosmos.

SKILLS

ENTROPIC MAGIC · SL max 10

Each level learns one Entropist spell. Offensive spells use (INS + WLP) for the Magic Check.

ABSORB MP · SL max 5

After you suffer damage, recover (SL × 2) MP.

LUCKY SEVEN · SL max 1

You have a lucky number — 7 at each session's start. Once per scene, after rolling a Check, replace one die's value with it (impossible values allowed); the replaced value becomes your new lucky number.

STOLEN TIME · SL max 4

Action + up to (SL × 5) MP; each 5 MP buys one option, once each: inflict slow; cure slow; a slowed enemy loses (10 + SL × 5) HP; a creature takes a free Equipment action; an ally yet to act takes their turn after yours. Variant available: Second Slicer — free attack, +(SL) Accuracy, inflicts slow with riders. Chosen permanently.

EMBRACE CHAOS! · SL max 1

When performing a Ritual, after paying MP: grow its area one stage free, rolling a d20 beside the Magic Check — beat the Check's result or hit its difficulty exactly and the Ritual misfires catastrophically.

POINTS OF LIGHT · SL max 8

Settlements you rest in become points of light: speak with familiar people across any of them at any distance, and the group's costs to rest, resupply IP or secure lodging fall while inside one.

QA: Entropist

  • Source: Fabula Ultima: Core Rulebook, pp. 131–134
  • Rename: None (printed name is canonical)
  • Heroics: Via compendium (see HEROICS-compiled.md)

SPELLS

EBON LACQUER · 5 MP · One equipped weapon · Scene

You imbue a weapon with dark energy. Until this spell ends, all damage dealt by the weapon becomes dark. If you have that weapon equipped while you cast this spell, you may perform a free attack with it as part of the same action. This spell can only be cast on a weapon equipped by a willing creature.

PSYCHICAL DEPLETION [Z] · 5 MP · One creature · Instantaneous

You consume a creature's psyche. The target loses (HR + 20) Mind Points. Then, you recover an amount of Mind Points equal to half the total Mind Points loss they suffered (if the target had no MP left, you recover none).

DISSOLUTION · 10 MP · One creature · Instantaneous

You cleanse all magic from a creature. The target stops being affected by all spells with a duration of "Scene" that are affecting them.

PROGNOSTIC SURVEY · 10 MP · Self · Scene

You briefly glimpse into the future. Until this spell ends, after a creature you can see rolls dice for a Check, if it is not a fumble or a critical success, you may force them to reroll both dice. Once you have forced two rerolls this way, this spell ends.

THE BULSTRODE TRANSFER [Z] · 10 MP · One creature · Instantaneous

You steal another creature's life force. You deal (HR + 15) dark damage to the target. Then, you recover an amount of Hit Points equal to half the total Hit Points loss they suffered (if the target had no HP left, you recover none).

SPECULAR REVERSION · 10 MP · One creature · Scene

You twist the laws of magic. Until this spell ends, when the target is targeted by an offensive spell (O), the creature that cast that offensive spell will be targeted in their stead (any other targets of the offensive spell will be targeted as normal). Once that happens, this spell ends.

TEMPORAL ARREST [Z] · 10 MP · One creature · Instantaneous

You trap a foe inside a circle of altered time and space. The target will perform one fewer action on their next turn (to a minimum of 0 actions).

UMBRAL EXTRACTION [Z] · 10 × T MP · Up to three creatures · Instantaneous

A storm of dark energy turns matter into ash. You deal (HR + 15) dark damage to each target hit by this spell. Opportunity: each target hit by this spell suffers weak.

MORTAL ABATEMENT [Z] · 15 MP · One creature · Instantaneous

You invoke doom on your foe, turning strength into frailty. The target loses an amount of Hit Points equal to (20 + half their level).

KINETIC AUGMENTATION · 20 MP · One creature · Scene

At the end of each of their turns, the target may choose one option: perform a free attack with a weapon they have equipped; or perform the Spell action for free, casting a spell with a total MP cost equal to or lower than 10 (paying its MP cost). After the same creature benefits from this effect a second time, this spell ends.

ABERRANT SUSCEPTIBILITY [Z] · 20 MP · One creature · Scene

You alter the very nature of your target. Until this spell ends, if the target would suffer damage of a type they Absorb or are Immune to, they are instead treated as if they were Vulnerable to that damage type. Once that happens, this spell ends.

ALEATORY TRIAL · up to 20 MP · Special · Instantaneous

You summon a vortex of chaotic energy. Roll your current Willpower die once for every 10 Mind Points spent while casting this spell, then keep the single die you prefer: the number on that die determines the effects of this spell. [1: Lose half current HP and MP] [2-3: Each creature present (including self) suffers poisoned] [4-6: Each creature present (including self) suffers slow] [7-8: Choose up to three creatures you can see — each recovers 50 HP and recovers from all status effects] [9: Choose any number of creatures you can see — deal 30 damage to each] [9+ damage type determined by rolling d6: 1=air, 2=bolt, 3=dark, 4=earth, 5=fire, 6=poison]

THE PERIHELION · 50 MP · Special · Instantaneous

You rip open a large portal to the Cosmos, calling down astral debris from the gaping void. Choose one option: you deal 60 damage to one enemy you can see; or you deal 40 damage to every enemy you can see. These amounts increase by 5 if you are level 20 or higher, or by 10 if you are level 40 or higher. Damage dealt by this spell has no type (thus being unaffected by damage Affinities).
